name: 东方故事二
english_name: Eastern Story II: The Celestial Empire
english_description: Part of the "Eastern Story" engine family shared with es1_win and esI in this project, but with independent, smaller-scale content — an early MUD established in 1995-1996. Offers four playable races (Human, Jiaojao, Woochan, Yenhold) drawing more on Western fantasy than wuxia sect traditions, with new characters beginning at a small inn greeted by an innkeeper and waiter in a leaner, old-school style typical of this engine family.
